name: Modern Middle East Studies
about: The Modern Middle East Studies major focuses on the culture, history, religion, politics, and society of the modern Middle East in its full geographical breadth, while developing expertise in major regional languages such as Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and Turkish. Drawing on courses from the humanities and social sciences, the major gives students the analytical and linguistic skills necessary to understand the complexity of the Middle East. It is designed for those pursuing graduate study or professional careers where regional expertise is essential.
